notes: Obstacle-only online task (simplified strike): random tall cylinders only, no chasers. Tarot 450-class action box (the slow-track box): collective thrust 0.5..1.5 g, roll/pitch rate 2 rad/s, yaw rate 0.5 rad/s. Hover LQR re-tuned for that box (design B of docker_batch/README_cyl_online.md: position weights x4, velocity x10 of the strike design, input weights rescaled by the input margins); base set c_B 20 certified (c_U 49.6): hover ellipsoid 0.40 m wide (radius), 0.17 m tall. Drone radius 0.35 m (450 mm frame + 10 in props), floor 0.5 m. Phase I: safe-arrival backup = hover LQR + learned residual (TD3), T 1.5 s, start speeds up to 2 m/s, 4 obstacle slots (observation 48). The network width is set per run (--hidden_size); run_cyl_online_phase1.sh trains 32, 64, 128 and 256.
